PurposeZh: 关闭防护状态提醒、保护关闭提示和安全中心托盘图标。
PurposeEn: Turn off protection status alerts, protection-off reminders and the security tray icon.
ImpactZh: 其他应用的通知弹窗、声音和通知中心由 Windows 管理。
ImpactEn: Windows continues to manage other application notifications, sounds and Notification Center.

PurposeZh: 关闭防火墙通知和连接新网络时的提示。
PurposeEn: Turn off firewall notifications and prompts for new networks.

PurposeZh: 关闭域、专用和公用网络的 Windows 防火墙。
PurposeEn: Turn off Windows Firewall for domain, private and public networks.

PurposeZh: 关闭用户账户控制，取消应用请求管理员权限时的确认。
PurposeEn: Turn off User Account Control and administrator approval prompts.
ImpactZh: 更改系统级权限控制，不仅是隐藏提示。
ImpactEn: Changes system-level privilege control, beyond hiding approval prompts.

PurposeZh: 关闭 Windows 对应用和下载文件的信誉检查。
PurposeEn: Turn off Windows reputation checks for applications and downloaded files.

PurposeZh: 关闭 Edge 对网站、下载文件和潜在不需要应用的信誉检查。
PurposeEn: Turn off Edge reputation checks for websites, downloads and potentially unwanted applications.

PurposeZh: 停止为新下载的文件标记来源，并减少打开文件时的安全提示。
PurposeEn: Stop marking the origin of newly downloaded files and reduce file-opening security prompts.
ImpactZh: 不会移除现有文件的来源标记。
ImpactEn: Existing file origin markers are not removed.

PurposeZh: 关闭智能应用控制对应用运行的拦截。
PurposeEn: Turn off Smart App Control application blocking.

PurposeZh: 禁用应用标识服务，停止 AppLocker 应用限制。
PurposeEn: Disable the Application Identity service used to enforce AppLocker restrictions.

Zh: 默认应用与任务栏保护
PurposeZh: 禁用对默认应用和部分任务栏设置的修改保护。
PurposeEn: Disable change protection for default applications and some taskbar settings.

PurposeZh: 禁用 Defender 的杀毒、网络检查和端点防护服务与驱动。
PurposeEn: Disable Defender antivirus, network inspection and endpoint protection services and drivers.

PurposeZh: 关闭对 Defender 设置的篡改防护。
PurposeEn: Turn off tamper protection for Defender settings.

PurposeZh: 关闭 Defender 对文件、脚本和程序行为的实时扫描。
PurposeEn: Turn off Defender real-time scanning of files, scripts and application behavior.

PurposeZh: 关闭 Defender 云端威胁查询、样本提交和首次发现拦截。
PurposeEn: Turn off Defender cloud threat checks, sample submission and block at first sight.

PurposeZh: 关闭对捆绑软件等潜在不需要应用的拦截。
PurposeEn: Turn off blocking of bundled software and other potentially unwanted applications.

PurposeZh: 关闭 Defender 对恶意网址的访问拦截。
PurposeEn: Turn off Defender blocking of malicious network addresses.

Ops.Path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Windows Defender Exploit Guard\Network Protection
Ops.Name: EnableNetworkProtection

PurposeZh: 关闭受控文件夹访问对应用修改文件的限制。
PurposeEn: Turn off Controlled Folder Access restrictions on application file changes.

Ops.Path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Windows Defender Exploit Guard\Controlled Folder Access
Ops.Name: EnableControlledFolderAccess

PurposeZh: 关闭攻击面减少规则对程序行为的限制。
PurposeEn: Turn off Attack Surface Reduction restrictions on application behavior.

PurposeZh: 禁用 Defender 的定时扫描、扫描缓存维护和记录清理任务。
PurposeEn: Disable Defender scheduled scanning, scan cache maintenance and history cleanup tasks.

PurposeZh: 安装微信输入法，用于中文输入与词库同步。
PurposeEn: Install WeType for Chinese text input and dictionary sync.

PurposeZh: 安装 UniGetUI，用于管理、安装和更新软件包。
PurposeEn: Install UniGetUI to manage, install and update software packages.

PurposeZh: 安装 chezmoi，用于管理和同步个人配置文件。
PurposeEn: Install chezmoi to manage and sync personal configuration files.

PurposeZh: 安装 Git，用于代码版本管理。
PurposeEn: Install Git for source code version control.

PurposeZh: 安装 uv，用于管理 Python 项目、环境与依赖。
PurposeEn: Install uv to manage Python projects, environments and dependencies.

PurposeZh: 安装 AutoHotkey，用于自定义快捷键和桌面自动化。
PurposeEn: Install AutoHotkey for custom keyboard shortcuts and desktop automation.

PurposeZh: 安装 rustup，用于安装和管理 Rust 工具链。
PurposeEn: Install rustup to install and manage Rust toolchains.

PurposeZh: 安装 VS Code，用于代码编辑、调试与扩展开发。
PurposeEn: Install VS Code for code editing, debugging and extensions.

PurposeZh: 安装 GitHub CLI，用于在终端管理仓库、Issue 和 PR。
PurposeEn: Install GitHub CLI to manage repositories, issues and pull requests from the terminal.

PurposeZh: 安装 ChatGPT 桌面应用，用于对话、写作与代码辅助。
PurposeEn: Install the ChatGPT desktop app for conversations, writing and coding assistance.

PurposeZh: 安装 Node.js JavaScript 运行环境和 npm 包管理器。
PurposeEn: Install the Node.js JavaScript runtime and npm package manager.

PurposeZh: 安装 Python 3.14 语言运行环境。
PurposeEn: Install the Python 3.14 language runtime.

PurposeZh: 安装 fd，用于在终端快速查找文件。
PurposeEn: Install fd to find files quickly from the terminal.

PurposeZh: 安装 Yazi，用于终端文件管理与预览。
PurposeEn: Install Yazi for terminal file management and previews.

PurposeZh: 安装 PowerShell，用于命令行脚本与系统管理。
PurposeEn: Install PowerShell for scripting and system administration.

PurposeZh: 安装 fzf，用于终端交互式模糊查找。
PurposeEn: Install fzf for interactive fuzzy finding in the terminal.

PurposeZh: 安装 zoxide，用于根据使用记录快速跳转目录。
PurposeEn: Install zoxide to jump to directories based on usage history.

PurposeZh: 安装 Neovim 终端文本编辑器。
PurposeEn: Install the Neovim terminal text editor.

PurposeZh: 安装 Android SDK 命令行工具，用于管理开发环境。
PurposeEn: Install Android SDK command-line tools to manage the development environment.

PurposeZh: 安装 UU 远程，用于远程访问和控制电脑。
PurposeEn: Install UU Remote to access and control computers remotely.

PurposeZh: 安装 Windows Terminal 多标签终端。
PurposeEn: Install Windows Terminal, a terminal with multiple tabs.

PurposeZh: 安装 tailcat，用于加密点对点数据传输、端口转发和远程访问。
PurposeEn: Install tailcat for encrypted peer-to-peer transfers, port forwarding and remote access.

PurposeZh: 卸载新闻资讯与内容推荐应用。
PurposeEn: Uninstall the news and content recommendation application.

PurposeZh: 卸载天气预报应用。
PurposeEn: Uninstall the weather forecast application.

PurposeZh: 卸载 Xbox 应用与游戏栏。
PurposeEn: Uninstall Xbox applications and Game Bar.

PurposeZh: 卸载用于查看和管理系统防护的安全中心应用。
PurposeEn: Uninstall the Windows Security application used to view and manage protection settings.

PurposeZh: 卸载小组件与资讯面板的运行组件。
PurposeEn: Uninstall runtime components for Widgets and news feeds.

PurposeZh: 卸载纸牌和微软内置游戏。
PurposeEn: Uninstall Solitaire and Microsoft built-in games.

PurposeZh: 卸载 Edge 游戏助手。
PurposeEn: Uninstall Edge Game Assist.
ImpactZh: 需要时可从 Edge 菜单重新安装。
ImpactEn: It can be reinstalled from the Edge menu.

PurposeZh: 卸载额外的应用兼容性组件和修复数据库。
PurposeEn: Uninstall additional application compatibility components and fix databases.

PurposeZh: 卸载 Clipchamp 视频剪辑应用。
PurposeEn: Uninstall the Clipchamp video editing application.

PurposeZh: 卸载桌面便签应用。
PurposeEn: Uninstall the Sticky Notes application.

PurposeZh: 卸载微软待办应用。
PurposeEn: Uninstall the Microsoft To Do application.

PurposeZh: 卸载用于提交系统反馈的反馈中心。
PurposeEn: Uninstall Feedback Hub, used to submit system feedback.

PurposeZh: 卸载获取帮助与在线支持应用。
PurposeEn: Uninstall the Get Help and online support application.

PurposeZh: 卸载微软电脑管家。
PurposeEn: Uninstall Microsoft PC Manager.

PurposeZh: 卸载快速助手远程协助应用。
PurposeEn: Uninstall the Quick Assist remote assistance application.

PurposeZh: 卸载 Power Automate 桌面自动化应用。
PurposeEn: Uninstall the Power Automate desktop automation application.

Zh: 手机连接与跨设备应用
PurposeZh: 卸载手机连接和跨设备应用。
PurposeEn: Uninstall Phone Link and cross-device applications.

PurposeZh: 卸载家庭安全和家长控制应用。
PurposeEn: Uninstall Family Safety and parental control applications.

PurposeZh: 卸载 Outlook、邮件与日历应用。
PurposeEn: Uninstall Outlook, Mail and Calendar applications.

PurposeZh: 卸载 Dev Home 开发环境管理应用。
PurposeEn: Uninstall the Dev Home developer environment application.

PurposeZh: 卸载 Copilot 和微软内置 AI 应用。
PurposeEn: Uninstall Copilot and Microsoft built-in AI applications.

PurposeZh: 卸载 OneDrive 云端文件同步应用。
PurposeEn: Uninstall the OneDrive cloud file sync application.

PurposeZh: 关闭增强指针精度，鼠标速度设为 20，滚轮每次滚动 6 行。
PurposeEn: Turn off pointer acceleration, set pointer speed to 20 and scroll 6 lines at a time.

PurposeZh: 重复延迟设为 140 毫秒、间隔设为 16 毫秒；关闭粘滞键、筛选键及辅助按键提示。
PurposeEn: Set repeat delay to 140 ms and interval to 16 ms; turn off Sticky Keys, Filter Keys and accessibility key alerts.

PurposeZh: 将鼠标指针设为黑色，大小设为 3。
PurposeEn: Use a black mouse pointer at size 3.

PurposeZh: 将系统和应用设为浅色主题，关闭透明效果。
PurposeEn: Use light mode for Windows and applications, with transparency turned off.

PurposeZh: 关闭大部分视觉效果，仅保留字体平滑、窗口拖动内容和缩略图。
PurposeEn: Turn off most visual effects, keeping font smoothing, window contents while dragging and thumbnails.

PurposeZh: 启用“使用 Unicode UTF-8 提供全球语言支持”。
PurposeEn: Enable Unicode UTF-8 for worldwide language support.

PurposeZh: 仅保留微信输入法，移除微软拼音、美式键盘及其他输入方式。
PurposeEn: Keep WeType as the only input method, removing Microsoft Pinyin, the US keyboard and other input methods.

PurposeZh: 关闭插电和电池模式的自动息屏、睡眠与休眠；电源按钮、睡眠按钮和合盖设为无操作。
PurposeEn: Turn off automatic display timeout, sleep and hibernation on AC and battery; set power button, sleep button and lid actions to Do nothing.

PurposeZh: 关闭系统休眠并释放休眠文件占用的磁盘空间。
PurposeEn: Turn off hibernation and free the disk space used by its file.
ImpactZh: 删除 hiberfil.sys，并关闭依赖休眠的快速启动；虚拟内存不受影响。
ImpactEn: Removes hiberfil.sys and disables Fast Startup; virtual memory is unaffected.

PurposeZh: 关闭最近使用和推荐内容，将全部应用设为列表并清空固定区。
PurposeEn: Turn off recent items and recommendations, use an app list and clear pinned applications.

PurposeZh: 桌面仅保留此电脑与回收站，将其他文件和快捷方式移入回收站。
PurposeEn: Keep only This PC and Recycle Bin on the desktop; move other files and shortcuts to Recycle Bin.

PurposeZh: 任务栏靠左对齐，所有屏幕仅在任务栏已满时合并按钮。
PurposeEn: Align the taskbar left and combine buttons only when full on all displays.

Zh: 任务栏搜索与任务视图
PurposeZh: 隐藏任务栏搜索和任务视图按钮。
PurposeEn: Hide the taskbar Search and Task View buttons.

PurposeZh: 清空任务栏中已保存的固定应用。
PurposeEn: Clear applications saved as taskbar pins.
ImpactZh: 已打开的窗口仍会显示在任务栏；应用可重新固定。
ImpactEn: Open windows still appear on the taskbar; applications can be pinned again.

PurposeZh: 展开所有应用托盘图标，包括新增或更新后的图标。
PurposeEn: Show all application tray icons, including newly added or updated icons.

PurposeZh: 隐藏蓝牙托盘图标。
PurposeEn: Hide the Bluetooth system tray icon.

PurposeZh: 隐藏浮动语言栏和任务栏输入指示器。
PurposeEn: Hide the floating language bar and taskbar input indicator.

Zh: 文件扩展名与隐藏文件
PurposeZh: 显示文件扩展名与普通隐藏文件。
PurposeEn: Show file extensions and ordinary hidden files.
ImpactZh: 受保护的系统文件继续隐藏。
ImpactEn: Protected system files remain hidden.

PurposeZh: 将文件资源管理器的默认打开位置设为此电脑。
PurposeEn: Set File Explorer to open at This PC by default.

PurposeZh: 创建快捷方式时不添加“快捷方式”后缀。
PurposeEn: Create shortcuts without adding the Shortcut suffix.

PurposeZh: 在 Windows 11 右键菜单和 Windows 10 经典菜单之间切换。
PurposeEn: Switch between the Windows 11 context menu and the Windows 10 classic menu.

PurposeZh: 将桌面背景类型设为图片。
PurposeEn: Set the desktop background type to Picture.

PurposeZh: 关闭锁屏 Windows 聚焦和推荐内容。
PurposeEn: Turn off Windows Spotlight and recommendations on the lock screen.

PurposeZh: 关闭用于隔离敏感系统数据的虚拟化安全。
PurposeEn: Turn off virtualization-based security used to isolate sensitive system data.

PurposeZh: 关闭内存完整性对内核代码和驱动的检查。
PurposeEn: Turn off Memory Integrity checks on kernel code and drivers.

PurposeZh: 关闭用于隔离登录凭据的凭据保护。
PurposeEn: Turn off Credential Guard isolation of sign-in credentials.

PurposeZh: 关闭 LSA 登录安全进程的启动保护。
PurposeEn: Turn off startup protection for the LSA sign-in security process.
ImpactZh: 不停止正在运行的登录安全进程。
ImpactEn: The running sign-in security process is not stopped.

PurposeZh: 关闭内核调用栈的返回地址保护。
PurposeEn: Turn off return-address protection for the kernel call stack.

PurposeZh: 关闭 System Guard 的启动完整性防护。
PurposeEn: Turn off System Guard Secure Launch protection at startup.

PurposeZh: 关闭对已知存在漏洞驱动的加载拦截。
PurposeEn: Turn off loading restrictions for drivers with known vulnerabilities.

PurposeZh: 关闭危险密码输入、密码重复使用及不安全保存密码的提醒。
PurposeEn: Turn off warnings for unsafe password entry, password reuse and unsafe password storage.

PurposeZh: 禁用汇总杀毒和防火墙状态的安全中心服务。
PurposeEn: Disable Windows Security Center services that collect antivirus and firewall status.

PurposeZh: 关闭可配置的 Spectre、Meltdown 等 CPU 漏洞防护。
PurposeEn: Turn off configurable CPU mitigations for Spectre, Meltdown and related vulnerabilities.

PurposeZh: 关闭全局及 Windows 程序可配置的漏洞防护启动设置。
PurposeEn: Turn off configurable global and Windows application exploit protection startup settings.
ImpactZh: 已运行的进程保留原保护；Windows 强制或程序自行启用的保护可能保留。
ImpactEn: Running processes retain their protections; Windows-mandated or application-enabled protections may remain.

PurposeZh: 关闭可配置的数据执行保护（DEP）启动策略。
PurposeEn: Turn off the configurable Data Execution Prevention (DEP) boot policy.
ImpactZh: Windows 强制为 64 位程序启用 DEP。
ImpactEn: Windows mandates DEP for 64-bit applications.

Zh: 异常处理与服务进程保护
PurposeZh: 关闭内核异常处理链和系统服务进程的额外防护。
PurposeEn: Turn off additional protection for kernel exception chains and system service processes.

PurposeZh: 设置启动参数，关闭可调整的驱动完整性检查。
PurposeEn: Set the boot option to turn off configurable driver integrity checks.
ImpactZh: 实际检查受 Windows 启动验证和安全启动约束。
ImpactEn: Actual enforcement depends on Windows boot verification and Secure Boot.

PurposeZh: 将 Windows 时间服务设为自动启动并运行，保留当前校时服务器。
PurposeEn: Set Windows Time to Automatic and start it, keeping the current time server.

PurposeZh: 将 Windows 系统更新暂停期限设为 7000 天。
PurposeEn: Pause Windows system updates for 7000 days.
ImpactZh: 可在 Windows 更新页面手动恢复更新。
ImpactEn: Updates can be resumed manually in Windows Update.

PurposeZh: 排除 Windows 更新中的驱动，并关闭设备安装时的在线驱动搜索。
PurposeEn: Exclude drivers from Windows updates and turn off online driver searches during device setup.
ImpactZh: 仍可手动安装驱动。
ImpactEn: Drivers can still be installed manually.

PurposeZh: 关闭所有磁盘的系统保护，停止自动创建还原点。
PurposeEn: Turn off System Protection on all drives and stop automatic restore point creation.
ImpactZh: 可在系统属性中重新开启系统保护。
ImpactEn: System Protection can be enabled again in System Properties.

PurposeZh: 阻止 Windows 在符合条件的设备上自动开启磁盘加密。
PurposeEn: Prevent Windows from automatically enabling disk encryption on eligible devices.
ImpactZh: 不会解密已加密的磁盘。
ImpactEn: Already encrypted drives are not decrypted.

PurposeZh: 关闭可选诊断数据、遥测和错误报告后台服务及相关计划任务。
PurposeEn: Turn off optional diagnostic data, telemetry and error reporting services and related scheduled tasks.
ImpactZh: 保留 Windows 必需的诊断数据。
ImpactEn: Required Windows diagnostic data is retained.

PurposeZh: 关闭广告标识和基于诊断数据的个性化推荐。
PurposeEn: Turn off advertising ID and tailored experiences based on diagnostic data.

PurposeZh: 关闭系统推广、欢迎页面、设置建议和账户提醒。
PurposeEn: Turn off system promotions, welcome screens, Settings suggestions and account reminders.

PurposeZh: 停止记录应用启动频率，关闭相关的开始菜单和搜索个性化。
PurposeEn: Stop tracking application launch frequency for Start and search personalization.

PurposeZh: 关闭邀请用户提交体验反馈的提示。
PurposeEn: Turn off invitations to submit experience feedback.

PurposeZh: 关闭位置访问和应用请求位置时的通知。
PurposeEn: Turn off location access and notifications for application location requests.
ImpactZh: 保留 Windows 设置中的位置开关。
ImpactEn: Location switches remain available in Windows Settings.

PurposeZh: 禁用监测系统卡顿等性能问题的诊断追踪服务。
PurposeEn: Disable the diagnostic tracing service that monitors performance problems such as sluggishness.

PurposeZh: 禁用收集使用情况和体验质量数据的后台服务。
PurposeEn: Disable the background service that collects usage and experience quality data.

PurposeZh: 禁用智能卡移除时自动锁定或注销的策略服务。
PurposeEn: Disable the service that locks or signs out when a smart card is removed.

PurposeZh: 关闭 Windows 搜索中的热点和推荐内容。
PurposeEn: Turn off highlights and recommendations in Windows Search.

PurposeZh: 隐藏任务栏小组件入口。
PurposeEn: Hide the taskbar Widgets button.
ImpactZh: 仅隐藏入口；卸载运行库是独立项目。
ImpactEn: Only hides the button; uninstalling the runtime is a separate item.

PurposeZh: 禁用 Windows 文件搜索索引服务。
PurposeEn: Disable the Windows file search indexing service.
ImpactZh: 文件仍可搜索，但内容搜索可能变慢。
ImpactEn: Files remain searchable, but content searches may be slower.

PurposeZh: 关闭应用启动预读、预启动和预读记录，保留 SysMain 自动运行。
PurposeEn: Turn off application prefetching, prelaunch and operation recording while keeping SysMain running automatically.
ImpactZh: 内存压缩与内存页合并保持 Windows 当前设置。
ImpactEn: Memory compression and page combining retain their current Windows settings.

PurposeZh: 禁用应用兼容性监测和提示服务。
PurposeEn: Disable the application compatibility monitoring and prompt service.

PurposeZh: 禁用自动检测和排查系统问题的诊断策略服务。
PurposeEn: Disable the Diagnostic Policy service used to detect and troubleshoot system problems.

PurposeZh: 禁用运行自动诊断的服务主机。
PurposeEn: Disable the service host for automatic diagnostics.

PurposeZh: 禁用运行自动诊断的系统服务主机。
PurposeEn: Disable the system service host for automatic diagnostics.

PurposeZh: 禁用自动诊断和故障排查执行服务。
PurposeEn: Disable the service that executes automatic diagnostics and troubleshooting.

Zh: 清单采集与兼容性评估
PurposeZh: 禁用应用清单采集与兼容性评估服务。
PurposeEn: Disable the application inventory and compatibility assessment service.

PurposeZh: 允许通过 Windows 界面管理备份、文件历史记录和设置同步。
PurposeEn: Allow backup, File History and settings sync to be managed through Windows controls.

PurposeZh: 关闭从其他设备下载 Windows 和商店更新的点对点共享。
PurposeEn: Turn off peer-to-peer sharing for Windows and Store update downloads.
ImpactZh: 普通下载仍可使用，可在 Windows 设置中重新开启共享。
ImpactEn: Normal downloads remain available; peer sharing can be enabled again in Windows Settings.

PurposeZh: 关闭远程桌面连接。
PurposeEn: Turn off Remote Desktop connections.
ImpactZh: 可在 Windows 设置中重新开启。
ImpactEn: It can be enabled again in Windows Settings.

PurposeZh: 关闭 Windows 远程协助。
PurposeEn: Turn off Windows Remote Assistance.
ImpactZh: 可在系统属性中重新开启。
ImpactEn: It can be enabled again in System Properties.

PurposeZh: 关闭在线语音识别、输入个性化和应用诊断信息访问。
PurposeEn: Turn off online speech recognition, input personalization and access to application diagnostic information.

PurposeZh: 禁用监测恶意站点和密码泄露的钓鱼防护后台服务。
PurposeEn: Disable phishing protection background services that monitor malicious sites and exposed credentials.

PurposeZh: 关闭跨设备共享、附近共享和相关连接后台服务。
PurposeEn: Turn off cross-device sharing, Nearby Sharing and related connection services.

PurposeZh: 关闭在此电脑上接续其他设备任务的功能。
PurposeEn: Turn off resuming tasks from other devices on this computer.

PurposeZh: 关闭剪贴板历史记录。
PurposeEn: Turn off clipboard history.

PurposeZh: 关闭游戏录制和后台捕获。
PurposeEn: Turn off game recording and background capture.

PurposeZh: 禁用 Recall 屏幕快照与历史回顾可选组件。
PurposeEn: Disable the Recall optional component for snapshots and activity history.

PurposeZh: 关闭关机时保存内核会话的快速启动。
PurposeEn: Turn off Fast Startup, which saves the kernel session at shutdown.

PurposeZh: 关闭为系统更新和临时文件预留的存储空间。
PurposeEn: Turn off storage reserved for system updates and temporary files.

Zh: Edge 预启动与后台运行
PurposeZh: 将 Edge 启动增强和关闭后后台运行的默认值设为关闭。
PurposeEn: Set Edge startup boost and background mode defaults to off.
ImpactZh: 可在 Edge 设置中更改。
ImpactEn: These options can be changed in Edge Settings.

PurposeZh: 关闭 Windows 搜索中的联网建议和网页结果。
PurposeEn: Turn off online suggestions and web results in Windows Search.
ImpactZh: 保留本地搜索；商店结果可能随 Windows 版本一并关闭。
ImpactEn: Local search remains available; Store results may also be hidden, depending on Windows version.

Zh: 联系人与用户数据后台
PurposeZh: 禁用联系人索引及用户数据存储和访问后台服务。
PurposeEn: Disable background services for contact indexing and user data storage and access.
ImpactZh: 依赖这些服务的联系人和日历应用无法同步。
ImpactEn: Contacts and calendar applications that depend on these services cannot sync.

PurposeZh: 禁用打印后台和打印工作流服务。
PurposeEn: Disable the print spooler and print workflow services.
ImpactZh: 实体打印和打印到 PDF 均不可用。
ImpactEn: Physical printing and Print to PDF become unavailable.

PurposeZh: 禁用网络设备发现、UPnP 和 WPS 配置服务。
PurposeEn: Disable network device discovery, UPnP and WPS configuration services.
ImpactZh: 保留 USB 即插即用、无线网络和蓝牙连接。
ImpactEn: USB Plug and Play, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connections remain available.

PurposeZh: 禁用网络流量使用统计后台服务。
PurposeEn: Disable background network data usage reporting.
ImpactZh: 网络连接和数据传输不受影响。
ImpactEn: Network connections and data transfer are unaffected.
